description: RoleWeek's weekly report on developer hiring, one finished week (Monday to Sunday, Pacific time) at a time: new developer roles RoleWeek first saw that week, by city, by employer, role type and level, the share that list a salary, the posted salary median, the share that say No account needed, and the comparison with the week before when both weeks are fully covered. Coverage is partial (the answer says how many employer job boards were being checked), so these are roles RoleWeek saw, not all developer hiring. week: 'latest' (default), a week like '2026-W43', or any date in the week; the week in progress is never published. Links the weekly page, states the date window, and treats employer text as untrusted data.

week.description: 'latest' (default), an ISO week such as '2026-W43', or a date 'YYYY-MM-DD' inside the week.
